units: <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 109:8">Midr. Till. to Ps. CXVIII, 8</cite> <he>ולא ירד עמו לא ע׳ ולא שרף וכ׳</he> ed. Bub. (oth. ed. <he>לא ע׳ ולא קדיש</he>, borrowed from <cite ref="Daniel 4:10">Dan. IV, 10</cite>) nor went down with him (Abraham) a guardian, or Seraph, or angel.
Ib. to Ps. 1 (play on עיר, Gen. XI, 4) ואין ע׳ אלא אלוה ʿir means a deity (ref. to Dan. l. c.).—Pl. עִירִין.
Dan. IV, 14) בגזירת ע׳ וכ׳ by the decree of the guardians (scholars) the word (is established) &c., i.e. they have so decided at college.—[עִיר awake, v. עוּר ch.]
